rnea_compensator_config._comment: RIGHT HAND RNEA config, SEEDED (not independently calibrated). conventions (wrench_sign, imu_offset, accel_is_specific_force) copied from the LEFT hand; mass/com/inertia taken from the right hand's latest Bota estimate. wrench_sign is UNVERIFIED for the right hand — a wrong global sign makes RNEA ADD instead of subtract. VALIDATE with a static tilt (compensated wrench should stay ~0 as you reorient; if it grows worse, flip wrench_sign) before trusting RNEA on the right. The viz surfaces this via wrench_sign_verified=false. As with the left, the UMI adapter zeroes geometry.imu_offset at runtime because the 12-vector IMU is already at the sensor origin. A Recompensation on this hand overwrites mass/com/inertia (inertia has ZERO effect on the force residual — only torque — so mass/com are what matter for force anti-shake).

geometry._comment: sensor-origin -> IMU point [m], SENSOR axes. STANDALONE value; the UMI adapter zeroes this at runtime.

conventions._comment: wrench_sign copied from LEFT and NOT verified on the right hand — see top _comment. wrench_sign_verified=false makes the viz warn.
